prompt:
Create ONE large boss monster sprite for a modern 16-bit-style pixel-art RPG battle (a single figure).

Image 1 is a LAYOUT GUIDE: the light-grey box shows where the boss stands and how big it is (fill the box), the grey line is the ground, and the arrow shows the facing: the boss faces RIGHT, toward the heroes. Never draw the grey box, line or arrow.

Image 2 is the HOUSE STYLE: an approved hero sprite sheet from this same game. Match its sprite-pixel size, black outlines, crisp cel shading and level of detail exactly, but do NOT copy the hero.

Render as true pixel art: the boss about 140-168 pixels tall in sprite pixels, every sprite pixel a hard-edged square, no anti-aliasing, no gradients, rich detail and 3-4 tones per colour like a premium modern pixel-art boss.

Boss: Astos, a regal dark-elf usurper king, tall and slender, with ash-grey skin, long straight white hair, long pointed ears, sharp cruel features with narrow glowing violet eyes, and a jagged black iron crown; layered robes of deep violet and black with silver trim, reaching to his shins, over thin fitted silver armour (a silver breastplate and small pauldrons) with a high collar, black boots; he holds a tall black staff ending in a curved silver sickle blade upright in the hand on the left side of the image, the other hand open at his side; both feet on the ground; the whole figure, crown and sickle blade included, well below the top of the grey box (the crown tips about a tenth of the image below the top edge); palette of ash grey, white, deep violet, black and silver. FACE: his ash-grey elven face with narrow glowing violet eyes and long pointed ears is readable.

Pose: idle, a ready battle stance, facing right.

BODY: standing on two feet, both feet on the ground line.

Only the boss: no other characters, no scenery, no floor tiles, no text.
Background: solid flat magenta (#FF00FF) everywhere, no shadows, no borders, no panels.
Avoid: two creatures in one cell, different creatures in different cells, background scenery, floor tiles, shadows on the ground, magic effects outside the cell, text, frame, border, grid lines, blurry, soft shading, gradient, 3d render, a shield, a second weapon, wings, a throne, a beard, a hood.
